name: github
label: GitHub
description: Developer platform that allows developers to create, store, manage and share their code

find_issue.label: Find Issue
find_issue.description: Finds the first issue whose title matches your text.

title.label: Title
title.description: Words to look for in issue titles.

trigger_workflow_dispatch.label: Trigger Workflow Dispatch
trigger_workflow_dispatch.description: Starts a GitHub Actions workflow run, optionally waiting for it.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.description: Only workflows with a workflow_dispatch trigger can run. The workflow ID or file name, such as deploy.yml.

ref.label: Branch or Tag
ref.description: If a branch and a tag share a name, GitHub uses the tag.

inputs.label: Workflow Inputs
inputs.description: Read from the workflow file on the chosen branch or tag. A JSON object of the workflow_dispatch inputs, such as {"environment": "staging"}.

create_issue_ai.label: Create Issue (Agent)
create_issue_ai.description: Opens a new issue in a GitHub repository.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Repository owner login (user or org). Resolve via List My Repositories or Search Repositories.

labels.label: Labels
labels.description: Label names to attach. Resolve via List Repository Labels. A JSON list of label names, such as ["bug"].

assignees.label: Assignees
assignees.description: User logins to assign. Resolve via List Assignees. A JSON list of user logins, such as ["octocat"].

get_issue_ai.label: Get Issue (Agent)
get_issue_ai.description: Fetches the full details of a single issue by number.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Repository owner login (user or org). Resolve via List My Repositories or Search Repositories.

issue_number.label: Issue Number
issue_number.description: The issue (or pull request) number. Resolve via List Repository Issues or Search Issues and Pull Requests.

update_issue_ai.label: Update Issue (Agent)
update_issue_ai.description: Edits an existing issue, including closing or reopening it.

owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Repository owner login (user or org). Resolve via List My Repositories or Search Repositories.

issue_number.description: The issue number to update. Resolve via List Repository Issues.

state.description: The new state of the issue (open or closed).

state_reason.description: The reason for the state change (only used if State is set).

milestone.label: Milestone Number
milestone.description: Milestone number to associate. Resolve via List Milestones. To remove the issue's milestone instead, set Clear Milestone.

clear_milestone.description: Set to true to remove the issue's current milestone. Overrides Milestone Number.

labels.description: Replaces the full label set. Resolve names via List Repository Labels. A JSON list of label names, such as ["bug"].

assignees.label: Assignees
assignees.description: Replaces the full assignee set (logins). Resolve via List Assignees. A JSON list of user logins, such as ["octocat"].

owner.label: Owner

comments.label: Inline Comments
comments.description: Optional array of inline comments, e.g. [{"path":"file.ts","position":5,"body":"..."}].
